alt: The Studio+91 2025 desk calendar standing on a wooden desk: its spiral-bound cover shows “S+91” and “2025 Calendar” over a swirling starry night in blues and teal, a yellow moon above a riverside village in green hills.
caption: A 2025 calendar with a swirling landscape illustration stands open on a wooden desk.
description: A white spiral-bound desk calendar is propped up on a light wood surface. Its cover features a stylized illustration in deep blues, greens, and gold, depicting a swirling sky, a yellow sun, a winding river, and a small village nestled among hills. The text on the cover reads S+91 and 2025 CALENDAR.
